COURSE ASSESSMENT
➢ Five quizzes account for 40% of the final grade.

➢ Ten to fifteen labs account for 20% of the final grade

➢ The mid-term exam accounts for 20% of the final grade

➢ The research paper accounts for 20% of the final grade.

EXTRA CREDIT
❖ All the extra credit work is worth 2.5% credit. The bonus points will be added to the aggregate score
at the end of the semester.
❖ Mere submission or attempt will not result in a total score (1.0 points) allocated for the specific
activity.
❖ Grading scale: 90% to 100%: A | 80 to <90%: B | 70 to <80: C | 60 to <70%: D | <60%:F

ATTENDANCE
Missing more than three classes without an excuse
will result in a penalty of 10% of the students’ final percentage.

DEVICES
Violation of the phone/smartwatch policy may result in a 10-point deduction from an affected
assessment.

RESEARCH PRESENTATION
○ Document formatting requirements: 11 pts, single spacing, 1 inch margins (top, left, right,
bottom).
Activity 4: Submit a PowerPoint Presentation (PPT)– Due on Nov. 4

Grading Criteria
The assignment will be graded in a total of (scalable) 100 points.
1. Activity 1: Group Formation (5 PTS)
2. Activity 2: Uploaded 4 PDFS (15)
3. Activity 3: Uploaded 2 summaries in a single Word document adhering to the given guidelines (20)
4. Activity 4: Uploaded 1 PPT document adhering to the standard guidelines (60)
5. A late penalty of 20% will be applied to each overdue activity.
6. A penalty of 100% for failure to complete any of the above activities.

RESEARCH PAPER RUBRIC
The weightage for each section is expressed as a percentage of the full points allocated for the
assignment.
1. Abstract (10%)
2. Introduction (20%)
a. Citation needed
3. Research Methodologies (10%)
a. How are you conducting the research?
4. Body (40%)
a. Containing the major topics related to the research.
5. Results and Findings (10%)

Papers with a similarity
index of more than 15% will be rejected and awarded a zero score.
4. Using quoted texts directly in the paper should be highly discouraged. Any quoted texts will penalize 15%
of the score.
○ -5% for each incorrect statement in the text.
○ -20 % if submission did not comply the given template
○ -20% did not meet the number of page requirements.
